scope: bounded specification and qualification planning; not a production proof

properties.name: delivered_requires_verified_receipt
properties.requirement: Delivered is permitted only when receipt evidence has been re-verified and is bound to the exact logical message, recipient, envelope commitment, and protocol context.
properties.gap: The starter models receipt evidence as a Boolean; receipt bytes, cryptographic verification, and message/recipient/commitment binding are not modeled.
properties.negative_control: Allow delivered to become true without receiptEvidence, or drop the inboxCommitted conjunct; checker must find a violation.

properties.name: one_logical_inbox_commit_per_idempotency_key
properties.requirement: At most one application-visible inbox item may commit for a logical message/recipient idempotency key, including duplicate concurrent handlers and cross-route retries.
properties.gap: The starter has one Boolean inboxCommitted and cannot represent duplicate keys, concurrent commits, or conflicting payloads.
properties.negative_control: Permit two distinct inbox commits for the same key; checker must find a violation.
properties.implementation_mapping: receiver persistence/application-acceptance boundary; exact implementation path requires repository mapping

properties.name: durable_accepted_outbox_does_not_disappear
properties.requirement: An accepted, unexpired durable outbox item cannot silently disappear under the declared storage durability assumptions.
properties.gap: Crash/restart models worker availability and recovery classification, but no durable/non-durable record layers, torn writes, lost writes, or storage recovery rules are represented.
properties.negative_control: Erase an accepted outbox item during recovery; checker must find a violation.
properties.implementation_mapping: durable outbox/storage boundary; backend intentionally unspecified

properties.name: stale_worker_epoch_cannot_authorize_send
properties.requirement: A worker whose lease epoch differs from the authoritative worker epoch cannot authorize a new send or commit authoritative state.
properties.gap: The model has one epoch pair and no concurrent worker-local state or stale worker commit after a newer epoch acquires the lease.
properties.negative_control: Remove the epoch-equality guard; checker must find a stale-worker authorization.

properties.name: no_new_send_after_expiry_or_revocation
properties.requirement: A new send authorization is impossible at or after expiry or after the applicable consent/policy generation is revoked. Outcomes of already in-flight attempts may still be recorded truthfully.
properties.gap: Expiry is Boolean rather than time-based; policy generation and the race between final authorization and transport invocation are not modeled.
properties.negative_control: Remove either authorization guard; checker must find a violating send authorization.

properties.name: conflicting_identity_reuse_fails_closed
properties.requirement: Reusing a message, event, attempt, or idempotency identity with conflicting committed content or context produces an explicit conflict, never silent replacement or success.
properties.gap: No identity/content commitment map or Conflict state exists in the starter.
properties.negative_control: Allow the same identity to map to two commitments; checker must find a violation.
properties.implementation_mapping: event journal and receiver inbox identity boundary

properties.name: replay_is_deterministic_and_idempotent
properties.requirement: Applying the same valid event history once or repeatedly yields the same authoritative state; gaps, malformed history, unsupported versions, and tampering cannot silently yield trusted state.
properties.gap: The starter has no event log, revision sequence, replay function, or schema/version validation.
properties.negative_control: Let replay order alter trusted terminal state or accept a revision gap; checker must find a violation.

properties.name: retry_and_history_resources_are_bounded
properties.requirement: Attempts, retry history, and journal growth remain within declared limits at both the exact limit and limit+1; overflow fails closed or compacts under a separately specified safe rule.
properties.gap: Only worker epoch is currently bounded; retry and history resources are absent.
properties.negative_control: Allow limit+1 entries without an explicit overflow/compaction decision; checker must find a violation.

properties.name: ambiguous_transport_outcome_never_becomes_success_by_inference
properties.requirement: A timeout, link/gateway acknowledgment, or lost response cannot be promoted to verified recipient delivery without the required receipt evidence.
properties.starter_model_mapping: RecoverInterruptedAttempt and UnknownIsNotDelivered model only the interrupted-attempt unknown state
properties.gap: Only recovery from an interrupted attempt maps to unknown; no explicit DefinitelyNotSent/PossiblySent/TransportAccepted taxonomy, lost-response state, or gateway acknowledgment class is modeled.
properties.negative_control: Map a timeout or transport acknowledgment directly to Delivered; checker must find a violation.
properties.implementation_mapping: transport adapter outcome normalization and delivery-state reducer

properties.name: liveness_is_conditional_and_non_vacuous
properties.requirement: Under stated fairness, durable-storage availability, permission, unexpired lifetime, working route, and responsive recipient assumptions, eligible work eventually reaches a documented evidence-backed or terminal state.
properties.gap: No liveness property or environmental fairness assumptions are checked; the finite worker-epoch bound permits runs to stop without eventual recovery.
properties.negative_control: Suppress all progress actions while claiming eventual progress; the liveness checker must reject the mutant under declared fairness assumptions.

execution_record.commit_binding: must be added by a reproducible qualification run
execution_record.note: A starter-model mapping is not a checker result. Every property requires syntax validation, non-vacuity review, and mutant sensitivity before any PASS claim.
